sources.title: Item tooltip screenshots sent by the owner (three Radiant items, all 21 Set 18 emblems, all 36 craftable items)
sources.note: Taken from a stats site, not the game client: one tooltip has a Recommended Holders panel, some show unfilled placeholders (Ally Healing: 0, increased to 0), Crownguard still shows the pre-18.4 25% AP. The site leaves stats out: no Damage Amp on any item, no Health on Gargoyle Stoneplate, Steadfast Heart, Evenshroud, Sunfire Cape, Nashor's Tooth, and no stat line at all on 9 items, while the older game-file copies have them. Its numbers predate 18.3 (emblems: Hunter 18% AD, Invoker 3 Mana Regen, Juggernaut 15 Mana, Brawler 2%) and 18.4 (Elderwood 35 resists, Crownguard). Used as support where it agrees and as conflicts where it differs.

sources.title: Owner's in-game check, patch 18.4b (screenshot and notes)
sources.note: Screenshot of the shop bar at level 7: odds 16% / 30% / 43% / 10% / 1%, XP 20/56, Buy XP 4 gold. Owner's notes from the game: level 8 odds 15/20/32/30/3, level 9 10/17/25/33/15, reroll 2 gold, Buy XP gives 4 XP, 2 XP every round, 7->8 56 XP, 8->9 and 9->10 68 XP. Round income at stage 4-7 (owner's notes): 0 gold with a 4 win streak -> +6, 0 gold with a 5 win streak -> +7, 20 gold with a 6 win streak -> +10; 30 gold, 6 win streak broken by a loss -> +8 (no streak bonus). The owner then said the win-streak totals include the +1 win gold, and that a won round pays +1 gold. Step-by-step round: 5 wins before, 14 gold before combat, 15 after the win, sold a unit to 20, 30 at the next round start. Owner first said a 2-round streak pays no extra gold, then measured it: 0 gold, 1 win before the round, won -> +7 (1 win + 5 base + 1 streak). Loss streaks pay the same streak gold as win streaks (only the +1 win gold is missing). Wisps: rightmost slot with 4 champions; a champion under it is revealed at combat start; 1 Wisp per round; after buying it the later shops of that round show 5 champions; prices vary, some 0 gold. 2026-10-21: no bad luck protection; Lux is one 5-cost in the pool with a random form shown in the shop, locked to the owned form until it is sold; dual-form champions are one champion each. Riftbeast (5) overrun shop: all 5 slots, normal level odds; Alpha Mark can be moved at any time. Emblems: the game does not let you put an emblem on a champion that already has its trait; it has to go on another champion. 2026-10-22: a champion shown in any player's shop stays out of the pool until that shop is refreshed.

Trait roster (headed 18.4, values equal the 18.5 game file except Hunter 4 at 45%, the game file value the 18.3 notes changed to 40%). Murkwolf's shown damage 500/1050/2250 disagrees with its own formula. 2026-10-23: screenshots of the ability boxes of Aphelios, Maokai, Rammus, Malphite and Rakan show the scaling icons (Aphelios swipes +1 per 20% bonus Attack Speed; Maokai damage in % max Health; Rammus Armor + MR; Malphite AP + Armor + MR).
